subject: project:gdl
value: RUN-32 EVIDENCE LAYER: SHIPPED MEASUREMENTS, for later lanes to compare against rather than re-derive. All figures measured 2026-09-02 on the merged corpus. CORPUS SHAPE: 1552 accepted records, of which 366 are law records and 1016 attempts. Attempt outcomes: parked 378, improved 352, capped 201, negative 45, neutral 29, exact 8, plus three one-off merge/retention spellings. 630 attempts carry laws_applied, citing 250 distinct law ids across 1912 citations; 7 cited ids dangle (no such record), all of them ids missing their date/version suffix. 79 refutes citations exist against 77 distinct targets, of which only 8 targets are laws. SCORING OUTCOME: 320 records receive an evidence row. Of 357 laws surfaced by `laws`, 199 are established, 5 contested, 3 refuted, and 150 provisional - so 42% of the law corpus has never been cited by an attempt that landed. That number is the layer's single most useful output: it is not a claim that those 150 laws are wrong, but it is a claim that the corpus cannot currently tell you which of them are right. CITATION-VERSUS-LANDING SPREAD: the most-cited law (claim.law.identical-multiset-is-blind-to-displacements.20260831.v1) has 147 citations but 13 landings, because 112 of its citations are parks it correctly predicted. Any future consumer reading citation counts as a proxy for reliability will therefore be wrong by an order of magnitude on exactly the project's best negative screens; read n, not cited_total. TOP OF THE RANKED VIEW, for comparison after the next wave: offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web 41/0 Wilson 0.914; C1_permute-recolor-composition 29/0 at 0.883; multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing.v2 22/0 at 0.851; stack-slots-descend-in-declaration-order 21/0 at 0.845. CANARY: 15 hand-scored laws, 15 reproduced, on three independent checks (tier agreement, a raw-JSON recount that shares no code with the shipped path, and the ordering invariant). The ordering invariant is the one that matters: the contested law at Wilson 0.646 ranks 200, below the known-winner at Wilson 0.207 at rank 138.
